# StarCode CLI

> A Rust-based AI coding assistant for the terminal. Chat with GPT, Claude, DeepSeek and 20+ LLM providers — with file editing, semantic search, and AI-assisted git workflows.

## What is StarCode CLI?

StarCode CLI is an open-source command-line AI coding assistant built with Rust. It brings conversational AI directly into your terminal with a beautiful interactive TUI (terminal user interface), enabling developers to write, edit, and understand code without leaving their workflow.

## Key Features

- **Interactive Terminal UI** — Full-featured TUI built with Ratatui. Chat, scroll, keyboard shortcuts, no browser needed.
- **20+ LLM Providers** — OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu AI, DouBao, SiliconFlow, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, Ollama, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- **File Operations** — Read, write, edit and patch files across your project. Multi-file edits in one shot.
- **Semantic Code Search** — Ripgrep-powered fast search plus semantic understanding.
- **LSP Integration** — Language Server Protocol support for go-to-definition and diagnostics.
- **MCP Server Support** — Connect external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol.
- **AI Git Workflows** — Auto-generate commit messages, create PRs, analyze diffs.
- **Built with Rust** — Blazing fast, memory safe, cross-platform native binaries.

## Installation

**Linux / macOS:**
```
curl -fsSL https://starcode.sh/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows (PowerShell as Administrator):**
```
irm https://starcode.sh/install.ps1 | iex
```
